The 15th René du Cinéma Awards ceremony, presented by the Académie André Delvaux, honored the best films of 2025 in Belgium. It took place on 7 March 2026 at the Flagey, in the historic site of Place Eugène Flagey, Ixelles. This is the first edition to bear the name "René du Cinéma", following the end of the partnership between the Magritte Foundation and the Académie André Delvaux. Comedian Charline Vanhoenacker hosted the ceremony for the second year in a row. It was broadcast in Belgium on Auvio and Pickx+.
Drama film We Believe You won the Best Film, along with five other awards. Other winners included Reflection in a Dead Diamond with four, Flow and Heads or Fails with two each.
Awards and nominations
The nominations were announced on 6 February 2026, including newly-added categories for television. Drama film We Believe You led the nominations with eleven, followed by Kika with eight and Young Mothers with seven.
Winners are listed first, highlighted in boldface, and indicated with a double dagger ().
